title: Don't set force async to false in Fragment scripting mode
body: In the `Fragment` scripting mode (used by `createContextualFragment()`, `setHTMLUnsafe()` and the positional `*HTMLUnsafe()` methods with `runScripts: true`, and `innerHTML`/`outerHTML`/`insertAdjacentHTML()` when a Trusted Types default policy enables `runScripts`), the HTML parser does not set the `script` element's `parser document`. Previously, it still set `force async` to false, and because `prepare the script element` only resets `force async` to true when `parser document` is non-null, external scripts without `async` kept `force async` set to false once inserted. All three browser engines (Chromium, Gecko, and WebKit) instead leave `force async` as true in this case (`script.async` returns `true` before insertion, and external scripts without `async` execute as async once inserted). Only set `force async` to false in `#scriptTag` when `scripting mode` is not `Fragment` (i.e., when `parser document` is set). Fixes #13079. - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chromium (already matches this behavior) * Gecko (already matches this behavior) * WebKit (already matches this behavior) - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/63708 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: N/A (already implemented) * Gecko: N/A (already implemented) * WebKit: N/A (already implemented) - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: N/A - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: N/A - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
